question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: He walked **bare footed** into the room.
solution:
The correct answer is '**barefoot**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**barefoot**" is the correct form to use when referring to someone walking without shoes or socks.
 
• The original sentence contains "**bare footed**," which is not standard usage.
 
• **Option 2: bear feet** is incorrect as it conveys a different and unrelated meaning.
 
• **Option 3: barefooted** is grammatically acceptable but less commonly used than "barefoot."
 
• **Option 4: with naked feet** is unnecessarily verbose and not idiomatic.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He walked **barefoot**__ into the room."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: bear feet** is incorrect because "bear" refers to the animal and does not fit in this context.
 
• **Option 3: barefooted** can sometimes be used, but "barefoot" is the preferred and simpler form in modern English.
 
• **Option 4: with naked feet** is unnecessarily wordy and less natural in English usage.
